findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, translate, company_leads, read_pdf, read_web_page, extract_structured, summarize, fact_check, news, probe, due_diligence, classify, pii_check, llm_claude_sonnet, llm_gpt_mini, llm_llama, agent_health, ask_model, coordination_thread_snapshot_schema, discover_semantic, contact_kairos, poll_contact_kairos, mesh_list_nodes, mesh_list_bounties, mesh_register_node, mesh_post_bounty, mesh_claim_bounty, mesh_ledger, base_new-pools · Private data: search, translate, read_pdf, read_web_page, weather, can_pay, wallet_balance, token_risk, due_diligence, pii_check, llm_claude_sonnet, llm_gpt_mini, llm_llama, wallet_intelligence, rank, ask_model, honest_delivery_refusal_schema, contact_kairos, poll_contact_kairos, json_query, json_diff, json_flatten, json_schema-infer, json_validate, base_nonce, base_erc20-balance, base_live-balance, base_erc1155-balance, base_erc20-transfers, base_basename, base_erc721-tokens, base_nft-metadata, base_can-sell, base_pretrade · Public sink: search, company_leads, pii_check, discover_semantic, mesh_list_nodes, mesh_list_bounties, mesh_register_node, mesh_post_bounty, mesh_claim_bounty, mesh_ledger, base_new-pools · Destructive: can_pay, llm_claude_sonnet, llm_gpt_mini, llm_llama, guard, time_parse, time_format, validate_iban, money_format, base_new-pools.
